column1: # Upstream sources for the license texts under licenses/third-party/.
# One row per license file. Both tools/Fetch-ThirdPartyLicenses.ps1 (which downloads
# them) and ThirdPartyLicenseTests (which verifies them) read THIS file, so the pinned
# hashes live in exactly one place.
#   Version        the version actually bundled (see THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md)
#   File           file name, kept as upstream names it (note PCRE2's British LICENCE)
#   Sha256         SHA256 of the license file itself
#   Uri            where to fetch it; for ArchiveMember rows this is the source archive
#   ArchiveSha256  SHA256 of the archive (empty when Uri is the file itself)
#   ArchiveMember  path inside the archive (empty when Uri is the file itself)
# gitlab.freedesktop.org and gcc.gnu.org are behind bot protection that answers plain
# HTTP with an HTML challenge page, so the GStreamer/GNOME/GCC/mingw-w64 rows use each
# project's own GitHub mirror. The libffi row uses the tarball from GStreamer's own
# mirror, and its ArchiveSha256 is the value cerbero pins in recipes/libffi.recipe --
# i.e. the very archive the bundled libffi-7.dll was built from.
